name: Droost Knowledge
description: The version-keyed Drupal knowledge pack (Tier 0): served facts true for building on any Drupal site — site-planning grounding plus a shipped, offline deprecation ledger — with a deprecations MCP tool.
project_description: Droost Knowledge is the version-keyed Drupal knowledge pack (Tier 0): facts that hold for building on any Drupal site, served to AI agents offline. It ships a site-planning guideline topic (guidelines/topics/site-planning.md) that the base module's GuidelineProvider serves via the droost_guidelines tool, and a shipped, version-keyed deprecation ledger (data/deprecations/<major>.json) served at runtime by the DeprecationLedger service with zero network. One read-only MCP tool, droost_deprecations, looks up a symbol's deprecation (deprecated in X, removed in Y, replacement, change-record URL) by exact symbol, substring search, or returns ledger stats. It also ships a brain-seed dataset (data/brain-seed/<major>.yml) that bootstraps droost_brain before its first build, and a maintainer-side Drush ETL command (droost:knowledge:etl, alias dket) that regenerates the ledger from the installed core via nikic/php-parser — adopters ship the committed dataset and never run it. It has no config or permissions of its own and depends only on droost. Local development only.
